Try exact match first\n    if anno_name in REGION_MAPPING:\n        return REGION_MAPPING[anno_name]\n    # Try prefix matching (handles layer suffixes like \", layer 5\")\n    for prefix, region in REGION_MAPPING.items():\n        if anno_name.startswith(prefix):\n            return REGION_MAPPING[prefix]\n    # Try substring matching for complex names\n    anno_lower = anno_name.lower()\n    if 'thalamus' in anno_lower or 'thalamic' in anno_lower:\n        return 'Thalamus'\n    if 'hypothal' in anno_lower:\n        return 'Hypothalamus'\n    if 'cerebel' in anno_lower:\n        return 'Cerebellum'\n    if 'medulla' in anno_lower or 'medullar' in anno_lower:\n        return 'Medulla'\n    if 'midbrain' in anno_lower:\n        return 'Midbrain'\n    if 'hippocam' in anno_lower:\n        return 'Hippocampus'\n    if 'olfact' in anno_lower or 'piriform' in anno_lower:\n        return 'Olfactory'\n    if 'striatum' in anno_lower or 'putamen' in anno_lower:\n        return 'Striatum'\n    if 'pallid' in anno_lower or 'pallidum' in anno_lower:\n        return 'Pallidum'\n    if 'cortex' in anno_lower or 'cortical' in anno_lower:\n        return 'OtherCortex'\n    if 'amygdal' in anno_lower:\n        return 'CorticalSubplate'\n    if 'pons' in anno_lower or 'pontine' in anno_lower:\n        return 'Pons'\n    # Fallback\n    print(f'  WARNING: Unmapped annotation: \"{anno_name}\"')\n    return 'OtherCortex'\n\n\n# ============================================================\n# Data loading functions\n# ============================================================\n\ndef list_nwb_files(data_dir):\n    \"\"\"List all NWB files organized by subject.\"\"\"\n    subjects = sorted([d for d in os.listdir(data_dir)\n                      if os.path.isdir(os.path.join(data_dir, d)) and d.startswith('sub-')])\n    all_files = []\n    for sub in subjects:\n        sub_dir = os.path.join(data_dir, sub)\n        nwb_files = sorted([os.path.join(sub_dir, f)\n                           for f in os.listdir(sub_dir) if f.endswith('.nwb')])\n        for nwb_file in nwb_files:\n            all_files.append((sub, nwb_file))\n    return all_files\n\n\ndef compute_firing_rates_vectorized(spike_times_list, go_time, t_start, t_end, bin_width, n_bins):\n    \"\"\"\n    Compute firing rates for all neurons from spike times.\n\n    Args:\n        spike_times_list: list of arrays, one per neuron (absolute times)\n        go_time: float, go cue time (absolute)\n        t_start, t_end: window relative to go_time\n        bin_width: bin width in seconds\n        n_bins: number of bins\n\n    Returns:\n        fr: (n_neurons, n_bins) firing rate array\n    \"\"\"\n    n_neurons = len(spike_times_list)\n    fr = np.zeros((n_neurons, n_bins), dtype=np.float32)\n    bin_edges_start = go_time + t_start + np.arange(n_bins) * bin_width\n    bin_edges_end = bin_edges_start + bin_width\n\n    for i, spk in enumerate(spike_times_list):\n        if len(spk) == 0:\n            continue\n        # Only keep spikes in our window\n        mask = (spk >= go_time + t_start) & (spk < go_time + t_end)\n        spk_window = spk[mask]\n        if len(spk_window) == 0:\n            continue\n        # Assign spikes to bins\n        bin_idx = np.floor((spk_window - (go_time + t_start)) / bin_width).astype(int)\n        bin_idx = np.clip(bin_idx, 0, n_bins - 1)\n        np.add.at(fr[i], bin_idx, 1)\n\n    fr /= bin_width  # convert to firing rate (Hz)\n    return fr\n\n\ndef process_session(nwb_path, show_processing=False, session_idx=0):\n    \"\"\"\n    Process one NWB session file.\n\n    Returns:\n        dict with session data, or None if session should be skipped.\n    \"\"\"\n    t0 = time.time()\n\n    io = pynwb.NWBHDF5IO(nwb_path, 'r')\n    nwb = io.read()\n\n    # Extract subject info\n    subject_id = nwb.subject.subject_id if nwb.subject else os.path.basename(nwb_path).split('_')[0]\n    session_id = nwb.identifier\n\n    print(f'  Processing {session_id}...')\n\n    # ------ Extract trial info ------\n    trials = nwb.trials\n    n_trials = len(trials)\n    trial_starts = trials['start_time'][:]\n    trial_stops = trials['stop_time'][:]\n    instructions = trials['trial_instruction'][:]  # 'left' or 'right'\n    outcomes = trials['outcome'][:]  # 'hit', 'miss', 'ignore'\n    early_licks = trials['early_lick'][:]  # 'early' or 'no early'\n    auto_water = trials['auto_water'][:]  # 0 or 1\n    free_water = trials['free_water'][:]  # 0 or 1\n    photostim_onset = trials['photostim_onset'][:]  # time or 'N/A'\n    photostim_duration = trials['photostim_duration'][:]  # duration or 'N/A'\n\n    # ------ Get go cue times ------\n    be = nwb.acquisition['BehavioralEvents']\n    go_times = be.time_series['go_start_times'].timestamps[:]\n\n    assert len(go_times) == n_trials, f\"Go times ({len(go_times)}) != trials ({n_trials})\"\n\n    # ------ Get sample (tone) onset times for each trial ------\n    sample_starts = be.time_series['sample_start_times'].timestamps[:]\n\n    # Map sample_start to each trial: find the last sample_start before the go cue within each trial\n    tone_onset_per_trial = np.full(n_trials, np.nan)\n    for i in range(n_trials):\n        # Find sample events within this trial's window\n        in_trial = sample_starts[(sample_starts >= trial_starts[i]) & (sample_starts <= go_times[i])]\n        if len(in_trial) > 0:\n            # Take the LAST sample onset (in case of replays from early licking)\n            tone_onset_per_trial[i] = in_trial[-1]\n\n    # ------ Session selection criteria (applied to ALL behavioral trials) ------\n    # These criteria use the full session behavioral data, per the paper\n    behav_valid = (auto_water == 0) & (free_water == 0)\n    control_mask = behav_valid.copy()\n    for i in range(n_trials):\n        if photostim_onset[i] != 'N/A':\n            control_mask[i] = False\n        if early_licks[i] == 'early':\n            control_mask[i] = False\n\n    n_control = np.sum(control_mask)\n    if n_control > 0:\n        correct_control = np.sum(control_mask & (outcomes == 'hit'))\n        correct_rate = correct_control / n_control\n    else:\n        correct_rate = 0.0\n\n    correct_left = np.sum(control_mask & (outcomes == 'hit') & (instructions == 'left'))\n    correct_right = np.sum(control_mask & (outcomes == 'hit') & (instructions == 'right'))\n\n    if correct_rate < MIN_CORRECT_RATE:\n        print(f'  SKIP: correct rate {correct_rate:.2f} < {MIN_CORRECT_RATE}')\n        io.close()\n        return None\n\n    if correct_left < MIN_CORRECT_LEFT or correct_right < MIN_CORRECT_RIGHT:\n        print(f'  SKIP: correct left={correct_left}, right={correct_right} (need >={MIN_CORRECT_LEFT} each)')\n        io.close()\n        return None\n\n    # ------ Determine recording coverage ------\n    units = nwb.units\n    classification = units['classification'][:]\n    good_mask_units = classification == 'good'\n    anno_names = units['anno_name'][:]\n    good_mask_units &= np.array([a != '' and a is not None for a in anno_names])\n    good_indices_units = np.where(good_mask_units)[0]\n\n    if len(good_indices_units) == 0:\n        print(f'  SKIP: no good neurons')\n        io.close()\n        return None\n\n    # Get max recording time from obs_intervals of a representative unit\n    obs_intervals = units['obs_intervals'][good_indices_units[0]]\n    max_recording_time = obs_intervals[-1, 1] if len(obs_intervals) > 0 else 0\n\n    # ------ Trial filtering (behavioral + recording coverage) ------\n    valid_mask = behav_valid.copy()\n    valid_mask &= ~np.isnan(tone_onset_per_trial)\n\n    # Exclude trials beyond the neural recording period\n    for i in range(n_trials):\n        trial_end_abs = go_times[i] + T_END\n        if trial_end_abs > max_recording_time + 1.0:\n            valid_mask[i] = False\n\n    valid_indices = np.where(valid_mask)[0]\n\n    if len(valid_indices) < 2:\n        print(f'  SKIP: too few valid trials after recording filter ({len(valid_indices)})')\n        io.close()\n        return None\n\n    # ------ Extract good neurons ------\n    good_indices = good_indices_units\n    spike_times_all = units['spike_times']\n    spike_times_good = [spike_times_all[idx] for idx in good_indices]\n\n    annos_good = anno_names[good_mask_units]\n    neuron_regions = [map_anno_to_region(a) for a in annos_good]\n\n    n_neurons = len(good_indices)\n    print(f'  {n_neurons} good neurons, {len(valid_indices)} valid trials (of {n_trials}), correct rate={correct_rate:.2f}')\n\n    # ------ Compute firing rates per trial ------\n    neural_trials = []\n    input_trials = []\n    output_trials = []\n\n    # Get tongue tracking data for this session\n    bts = nwb.acquisition['BehavioralTimeSeries']\n    has_tongue = 'Camera0_side_TongueTracking' in bts.time_series\n    if has_tongue:\n        tongue_data = bts.time_series['Camera0_side_TongueTracking'].data[:]  # (n_frames, 3): x, y, likelihood\n        tongue_ts = bts.time_series['Camera0_side_TongueTracking'].timestamps[:]\n        tongue_y = tongue_data[:, 1]\n        tongue_likelihood = tongue_data[:, 2]\n\n    # Compute per-session tongue y percentiles for discretization\n    # Use all time points where tongue is visible (high likelihood)\n    if has_tongue:\n        tongue_visible = tongue_likelihood > 0.5\n        if np.sum(tongue_visible) > 100:\n            visible_y = tongue_y[tongue_visible]\n            p40 = np.percentile(visible_y, 40)\n            p60 = np.percentile(visible_y, 60)\n        else:\n            # Not enough visible tongue data\n            p40 = np.percentile(tongue_y, 40)\n            p60 = np.percentile(tongue_y, 60)\n\n    # Time bin centers relative to go cue\n    bin_centers = T_START + np.arange(N_BINS) * BIN_WIDTH + BIN_WIDTH / 2\n\n    for trial_idx in valid_indices:\n        go_time = go_times[trial_idx]\n\n        # --- Neural data: firing rates ---\n        fr = compute_firing_rates_vectorized(\n            spike_times_good, go_time, T_START, T_END, BIN_WIDTH, N_BINS\n        )  # (n_neurons, n_bins)\n        neural_trials.append(fr)\n\n        # --- Input 0: time from tone onset (seconds) ---\n        tone_time = tone_onset_per_trial[trial_idx]\n        tone_relative = tone_time - go_time  # tone onset relative to go cue (negative)\n        time_from_tone = bin_centers - tone_relative  # time since tone onset at each bin\n\n        # --- Input 1: photostimulation on/off ---\n        photostim = np.zeros(N_BINS, dtype=np.float32)\n        if photostim_onset[trial_idx] != 'N/A':\n            ps_onset = float(photostim_onset[trial_idx])\n            ps_duration = float(photostim_duration[trial_idx])\n            # photostim_onset is relative to trial start, need to convert to absolute then go-relative\n            # Actually check: is it absolute or relative?\n            # From NWB: photostim_onset is in seconds - need to check\n            # Let's check: photostim_start_times in BehavioralEvents has absolute times\n            # But trials table photostim_onset may be relative to go cue or absolute\n            # Let me compute relative to go cue\n            # The trial table stores these as strings, and from exploring data they look like\n            # they might be durations from trial start or absolute times\n            # Looking at the data: photostim_onset values are small (1.8) suggesting relative to trial start\n            ps_onset_abs = trial_starts[trial_idx] + ps_onset\n            ps_end_abs = ps_onset_abs + ps_duration\n            ps_onset_rel = ps_onset_abs - go_time\n            ps_end_rel = ps_end_abs - go_time\n\n            for b in range(N_BINS):\n                bc = bin_centers[b]\n                if ps_onset_rel <= bc < ps_end_rel:\n                    photostim[b] = 1.0\n\n        input_data = np.stack([time_from_tone.astype(np.float32), photostim], axis=0)  # (2, n_bins)\n        input_trials.append(input_data)\n\n        # --- Output 0: choice (left=0, right=1) ---\n        instr = instructions[trial_idx]\n        outcome = outcomes[trial_idx]\n        if outcome == 'hit':\n            choice = 0 if instr == 'left' else 1\n        elif outcome == 'miss':\n            choice = 1 if instr == 'left' else 0  # wrong lick = opposite\n        else:  # ignore\n            choice = 0 if instr == 'left' else 1  # assign instruction direction\n\n        # --- Output 1: outcome (ignore=0, miss=1, hit=2) ---\n        outcome_val = {'ignore': 0, 'miss': 1, 'hit': 2}[outcome]\n\n        # --- Output 2: early lick (no=0, yes=1) ---\n        early_val = 0 if early_licks[trial_idx] == 'no early' else 1\n\n        # --- Output 3: tongue y position (discretized, time-varying) ---\n        if has_tongue:\n            tongue_y_trial = np.zeros(N_BINS, dtype=np.float32)\n            for b in range(N_BINS):\n                bc_abs = go_time + bin_centers[b]\n                # Find closest tongue frame\n                t_idx = np.searchsorted(tongue_ts, bc_abs)\n                t_idx = min(t_idx, len(tongue_ts) - 1)\n                ty = tongue_y[t_idx]\n                if ty < p40:\n                    tongue_y_trial[b] = 0\n                elif ty < p60:\n                    tongue_y_trial[b] = 1\n                else:\n                    tongue_y_trial[b] = 2\n        else:\n            tongue_y_trial = np.ones(N_BINS, dtype=np.float32)  # default to middle\n\n        # Combine outputs: per-trial values + time-varying tongue\n        # Use int values for categorical outputs (required by decoder)\n        output_data = np.array([\n            np.full(N_BINS, choice, dtype=np.int64),\n            np.full(N_BINS, outcome_val, dtype=np.int64),\n            np.full(N_BINS, early_val, dtype=np.int64),\n            tongue_y_trial.astype(np.int64),\n        ], dtype=np.int64)  # (4, n_bins)\n        output_trials.append(output_data)\n\n    io.close()\n\n    elapsed = time.time() - t0\n    print(f'  Done in {elapsed:.1f}s')\n\n    return {\n        'neural_trials': neural_trials,\n        'input_trials': input_trials,\n        'output_trials': output_trials,\n        'neuron_regions': neuron_regions,\n        'subject_id': subject_id,\n        'session_id': session_id,\n        'n_neurons': n_neurons,\n        'n_trials': len(valid_indices),\n        'correct_rate': correct_rate,\n    }\n\n\ndef make_processing_plots(session_data, session_idx, nwb_path):\n    \"\"\"Generate processing visualization plots for a session.\"\"\"\n    import matplotlib\n    matplotlib.use('Agg')\n    import matplotlib.pyplot as plt\n\n    neural = session_data['neural_trials']\n    inputs = session_data['input_trials']\n    outputs = session_data['output_trials']\n    session_id = session_data['session_id']\n\n    n_trials = len(neural)\n    n_neurons = neural[0].shape[0] if n_trials > 0 else 0\n\n    bin_centers = T_START + np.arange(N_BINS) * BIN_WIDTH + BIN_WIDTH / 2\n\n    fig, axes = plt.subplots(4, 3, figsize=(18, 16))\n    fig.suptitle(f'Session: {session_id}\\n{n_neurons} neurons, {n_trials} trials', fontsize=14)\n\n    # 1. def map_anno_to_region(anno_name):
    """Map a detailed CCF annotation to a broad brain region category."""
    if not anno_name or anno_name == '':
        return None

    if anno_name in REGION_MAPPING:
        return REGION_MAPPING[anno_name]
    # Try prefix matching (handles layer suffixes like ", layer 5")
    for prefix, region in REGION_MAPPING.items():
        if anno_name.startswith(prefix):
            return REGION_MAPPING[prefix]
    # Try substring matching for complex names
    anno_lower = anno_name.lower()
    if 'thalamus' in anno_lower or 'thalamic' in anno_lower:
        return 'Thalamus'
    if 'hypothal' in anno_lower:
        return 'Hypothalamus'
    if 'cerebel' in anno_lower:
        return 'Cerebellum'
    if 'medulla' in anno_lower or 'medullar' in anno_lower:
        return 'Medulla'
    if 'midbrain' in anno_lower:
        return 'Midbrain'
    if 'hippocam' in anno_lower:
        return 'Hippocampus'
    if 'olfact' in anno_lower or 'piriform' in anno_lower:
        return 'Olfactory'
    if 'striatum' in anno_lower or 'putamen' in anno_lower:
        return 'Striatum'
    if 'pallid' in anno_lower or 'pallidum' in anno_lower:
        return 'Pallidum'
    if 'cortex' in anno_lower or 'cortical' in anno_lower:
        return 'OtherCortex'
    if 'amygdal' in anno_lower:
        return 'CorticalSubplate'
    if 'pons' in anno_lower or 'pontine' in anno_lower:
        return 'Pons'
    # Fallback
    print(f'  WARNING: Unmapped annotation: "{anno_name}"')
    return 'OtherCortex'

def list_nwb_files(data_dir):
    """List all NWB files organized by subject."""
    subjects = sorted([d for d in os.listdir(data_dir)
                      if os.path.isdir(os.path.join(data_dir, d)) and d.startswith('sub-')])
    all_files = []
    for sub in subjects:
        sub_dir = os.path.join(data_dir, sub)
        nwb_files = sorted([os.path.join(sub_dir, f)
                           for f in os.listdir(sub_dir) if f.endswith('.nwb')])
        for nwb_file in nwb_files:
            all_files.append((sub, nwb_file))
    return all_files


def compute_firing_rates_vectorized(spike_times_list, go_time, t_start, t_end, bin_width, n_bins):
    """
    Compute firing rates for all neurons from spike times.

    Args:
        spike_times_list: list of arrays, one per neuron (absolute times)
        go_time: float, go cue time (absolute)
        t_start, t_end: window relative to go_time
        bin_width: bin width in seconds
        n_bins: number of bins

    Returns:
        fr: (n_neurons, n_bins) firing rate array
    """
    n_neurons = len(spike_times_list)
    fr = np.zeros((n_neurons, n_bins), dtype=np.float32)
    bin_edges_start = go_time + t_start + np.arange(n_bins) * bin_width
    bin_edges_end = bin_edges_start + bin_width

    for i, spk in enumerate(spike_times_list):
        if len(spk) == 0:
            continue
        # Only keep spikes in our window
        mask = (spk >= go_time + t_start) & (spk < go_time + t_end)
        spk_window = spk[mask]
        if len(spk_window) == 0:
            continue
        # Assign spikes to bins
        bin_idx = np.floor((spk_window - (go_time + t_start)) / bin_width).astype(int)
        bin_idx = np.clip(bin_idx, 0, n_bins - 1)
        np.add.at(fr[i], bin_idx, 1)

    fr /= bin_width  # convert to firing rate (Hz)
    return fr


def process_session(nwb_path, show_processing=False, session_idx=0):
    """
    Process one NWB session file.

    Returns:
        dict with session data, or None if session should be skipped.
    """
    t0 = time.time()

    io = pynwb.NWBHDF5IO(nwb_path, 'r')
    nwb = io.read()

    # Extract subject info
    subject_id = nwb.subject.subject_id if nwb.subject else os.path.basename(nwb_path).split('_')[0]
    session_id = nwb.identifier

    print(f'  Processing {session_id}...')

    # ------ Extract trial info ------
    trials = nwb.trials
    n_trials = len(trials)
    trial_starts = trials['start_time'][:]
    trial_stops = trials['stop_time'][:]
    instructions = trials['trial_instruction'][:]  # 'left' or 'right'
    outcomes = trials['outcome'][:]  # 'hit', 'miss', 'ignore'
    early_licks = trials['early_lick'][:]  # 'early' or 'no early'
    auto_water = trials['auto_water'][:]  # 0 or 1
    free_water = trials['free_water'][:]  # 0 or 1
    photostim_onset = trials['photostim_onset'][:]  # time or 'N/A'
    photostim_duration = trials['photostim_duration'][:]  # duration or 'N/A'

    # ------ Get go cue times ------
    be = nwb.acquisition['BehavioralEvents']
    go_times = be.time_series['go_start_times'].timestamps[:]

    assert len(go_times) == n_trials, f"Go times ({len(go_times)}) != trials ({n_trials})"

    # ------ Get sample (tone) onset times for each trial ------
    sample_starts = be.time_series['sample_start_times'].timestamps[:]

    # Map sample_start to each trial: find the last sample_start before the go cue within each trial
    tone_onset_per_trial = np.full(n_trials, np.nan)
    for i in range(n_trials):
        # Find sample events within this trial's window
        in_trial = sample_starts[(sample_starts >= trial_starts[i]) & (sample_starts <= go_times[i])]
        if len(in_trial) > 0:
            # Take the LAST sample onset (in case of replays from early licking)
            tone_onset_per_trial[i] = in_trial[-1]

    # ------ Session selection criteria (applied to ALL behavioral trials) ------
    # These criteria use the full session behavioral data, per the paper
    behav_valid = (auto_water == 0) & (free_water == 0)
    control_mask = behav_valid.copy()
    for i in range(n_trials):
        if photostim_onset[i] != 'N/A':
            control_mask[i] = False
        if early_licks[i] == 'early':
            control_mask[i] = False

    n_control = np.sum(control_mask)
    if n_control > 0:
        correct_control = np.sum(control_mask & (outcomes == 'hit'))
        correct_rate = correct_control / n_control
    else:
        correct_rate = 0.0

    correct_left = np.sum(control_mask & (outcomes == 'hit') & (instructions == 'left'))
    correct_right = np.sum(control_mask & (outcomes == 'hit') & (instructions == 'right'))

    if correct_rate < MIN_CORRECT_RATE:
        print(f'  SKIP: correct rate {correct_rate:.2f} < {MIN_CORRECT_RATE}')
        io.close()
        return None

    if correct_left < MIN_CORRECT_LEFT or correct_right < MIN_CORRECT_RIGHT:
        print(f'  SKIP: correct left={correct_left}, right={correct_right} (need >={MIN_CORRECT_LEFT} each)')
        io.close()
        return None

    # ------ Determine recording coverage ------
    units = nwb.units
    classification = units['classification'][:]
    good_mask_units = classification == 'good'
    anno_names = units['anno_name'][:]
    good_mask_units &= np.array([a != '' and a is not None for a in anno_names])
    good_indices_units = np.where(good_mask_units)[0]

    if len(good_indices_units) == 0:
        print(f'  SKIP: no good neurons')
        io.close()
        return None

    # Get max recording time from obs_intervals of a representative unit
    obs_intervals = units['obs_intervals'][good_indices_units[0]]
    max_recording_time = obs_intervals[-1, 1] if len(obs_intervals) > 0 else 0

    # ------ Trial filtering (behavioral + recording coverage) ------
    valid_mask = behav_valid.copy()
    valid_mask &= ~np.isnan(tone_onset_per_trial)

    # Exclude trials beyond the neural recording period
    for i in range(n_trials):
        trial_end_abs = go_times[i] + T_END
        if trial_end_abs > max_recording_time + 1.0:
            valid_mask[i] = False

    valid_indices = np.where(valid_mask)[0]

    if len(valid_indices) < 2:
        print(f'  SKIP: too few valid trials after recording filter ({len(valid_indices)})')
        io.close()
        return None

    # ------ Extract good neurons ------
    good_indices = good_indices_units
    spike_times_all = units['spike_times']
    spike_times_good = [spike_times_all[idx] for idx in good_indices]

    annos_good = anno_names[good_mask_units]
    neuron_regions = [map_anno_to_region(a) for a in annos_good]

    n_neurons = len(good_indices)
    print(f'  {n_neurons} good neurons, {len(valid_indices)} valid trials (of {n_trials}), correct rate={correct_rate:.2f}')

    # ------ Compute firing rates per trial ------
    neural_trials = []
    input_trials = []
    output_trials = []

    # Get tongue tracking data for this session
    bts = nwb.acquisition['BehavioralTimeSeries']
    has_tongue = 'Camera0_side_TongueTracking' in bts.time_series
    if has_tongue:
        tongue_data = bts.time_series['Camera0_side_TongueTracking'].data[:]  # (n_frames, 3): x, y, likelihood
        tongue_ts = bts.time_series['Camera0_side_TongueTracking'].timestamps[:]
        tongue_y = tongue_data[:, 1]
        tongue_likelihood = tongue_data[:, 2]

    # Compute per-session tongue y percentiles for discretization
    # Use all time points where tongue is visible (high likelihood)
    if has_tongue:
        tongue_visible = tongue_likelihood > 0.5
        if np.sum(tongue_visible) > 100:
            visible_y = tongue_y[tongue_visible]
            p40 = np.percentile(visible_y, 40)
            p60 = np.percentile(visible_y, 60)
        else:
            # Not enough visible tongue data
            p40 = np.percentile(tongue_y, 40)
            p60 = np.percentile(tongue_y, 60)

    # Time bin centers relative to go cue
    bin_centers = T_START + np.arange(N_BINS) * BIN_WIDTH + BIN_WIDTH / 2

    for trial_idx in valid_indices:
        go_time = go_times[trial_idx]

        # --- Neural data: firing rates ---
        fr = compute_firing_rates_vectorized(
            spike_times_good, go_time, T_START, T_END, BIN_WIDTH, N_BINS
        )  # (n_neurons, n_bins)
        neural_trials.append(fr)

        # --- Input 0: time from tone onset (seconds) ---
        tone_time = tone_onset_per_trial[trial_idx]
        tone_relative = tone_time - go_time  # tone onset relative to go cue (negative)
        time_from_tone = bin_centers - tone_relative  # time since tone onset at each bin

        # --- Input 1: photostimulation on/off ---
        photostim = np.zeros(N_BINS, dtype=np.float32)
        if photostim_onset[trial_idx] != 'N/A':
            ps_onset = float(photostim_onset[trial_idx])
            ps_duration = float(photostim_duration[trial_idx])
            # photostim_onset is relative to trial start, need to convert to absolute then go-relative
            # Actually check: is it absolute or relative?
            # From NWB: photostim_onset is in seconds - need to check
            # Let's check: photostim_start_times in BehavioralEvents has absolute times
            # But trials table photostim_onset may be relative to go cue or absolute
            # Let me compute relative to go cue
            # The trial table stores these as strings, and from exploring data they look like
            # they might be durations from trial start or absolute times
            # Looking at the data: photostim_onset values are small (1.8) suggesting relative to trial start
            ps_onset_abs = trial_starts[trial_idx] + ps_onset
            ps_end_abs = ps_onset_abs + ps_duration
            ps_onset_rel = ps_onset_abs - go_time
            ps_end_rel = ps_end_abs - go_time

            for b in range(N_BINS):
                bc = bin_centers[b]
                if ps_onset_rel <= bc < ps_end_rel:
                    photostim[b] = 1.0

        input_data = np.stack([time_from_tone.astype(np.float32), photostim], axis=0)  # (2, n_bins)
        input_trials.append(input_data)

        # --- Output 0: choice (left=0, right=1) ---
        instr = instructions[trial_idx]
        outcome = outcomes[trial_idx]
        if outcome == 'hit':
            choice = 0 if instr == 'left' else 1
        elif outcome == 'miss':
            choice = 1 if instr == 'left' else 0  # wrong lick = opposite
        else:  # ignore
            choice = 0 if instr == 'left' else 1  # assign instruction direction

        # --- Output 1: outcome (ignore=0, miss=1, hit=2) ---
        outcome_val = {'ignore': 0, 'miss': 1, 'hit': 2}[outcome]

        # --- Output 2: early lick (no=0, yes=1) ---
        early_val = 0 if early_licks[trial_idx] == 'no early' else 1

        # --- Output 3: tongue y position (discretized, time-varying) ---
        if has_tongue:
            tongue_y_trial = np.zeros(N_BINS, dtype=np.float32)
            for b in range(N_BINS):
                bc_abs = go_time + bin_centers[b]
                # Find closest tongue frame
                t_idx = np.searchsorted(tongue_ts, bc_abs)
                t_idx = min(t_idx, len(tongue_ts) - 1)
                ty = tongue_y[t_idx]
                if ty < p40:
                    tongue_y_trial[b] = 0
                elif ty < p60:
                    tongue_y_trial[b] = 1
                else:
                    tongue_y_trial[b] = 2
        else:
            tongue_y_trial = np.ones(N_BINS, dtype=np.float32)  # default to middle

        # Combine outputs: per-trial values + time-varying tongue
        # Use int values for categorical outputs (required by decoder)
        output_data = np.array([
            np.full(N_BINS, choice, dtype=np.int64),
            np.full(N_BINS, outcome_val, dtype=np.int64),
            np.full(N_BINS, early_val, dtype=np.int64),
            tongue_y_trial.astype(np.int64),
        ], dtype=np.int64)  # (4, n_bins)
        output_trials.append(output_data)

    io.close()

    elapsed = time.time() - t0
    print(f'  Done in {elapsed:.1f}s')

    return {
        'neural_trials': neural_trials,
        'input_trials': input_trials,
        'output_trials': output_trials,
        'neuron_regions': neuron_regions,
        'subject_id': subject_id,
        'session_id': session_id,
        'n_neurons': n_neurons,
        'n_trials': len(valid_indices),
        'correct_rate': correct_rate,
    }


def make_processing_plots(session_data, session_idx, nwb_path):
    """Generate processing visualization plots for a session."""
    import matplotlib
    matplotlib.use('Agg')
    import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

    neural = session_data['neural_trials']
    inputs = session_data['input_trials']
    outputs = session_data['output_trials']
    session_id = session_data['session_id']

    n_trials = len(neural)
    n_neurons = neural[0].shape[0] if n_trials > 0 else 0

    bin_centers = T_START + np.arange(N_BINS) * BIN_WIDTH + BIN_WIDTH / 2

    fig, axes = plt.subplots(4, 3, figsize=(18, 16))
    fig.suptitle(f'Session: {session_id}\n{n_neurons} neurons, {n_trials} trials', fontsize=14)

    # 1. Mean firing rate across neurons and trials
    if n_trials > 0 and n_neurons > 0:
        all_fr = np.stack(neural)  # (n_trials, n_neurons, n_bins)
        mean_fr = np.mean(all_fr, axis=(0, 1))
        axes[0, 0].plot(bin_centers, mean_fr)
        axes[0, 0].axvline(0, color='r', linestyle='--', label='Go cue')
        axes[0, 0].set_title('Mean firing rate')
        axes[0, 0].set_xlabel('Time (s)')
        axes[0, 0].set_ylabel('FR (Hz)')
        axes[0, 0].legend()

        # 2. Single trial neural activity (heatmap)
        trial_idx = min(5, n_trials - 1)
        im = axes[0, 1].imshow(neural[trial_idx][:min(50, n_neurons)],
                               aspect='auto', extent=[T_START, T_END, 0, min(50, n_neurons)])
        axes[0, 1].axvline(0, color='r', linestyle='--')
        axes[0, 1].set_title(f'Trial {trial_idx} neural activity')
        axes[0, 1].set_xlabel('Time (s)')
        axes[0, 1].set_ylabel('Neuron')
        plt.colorbar(im, ax=axes[0, 1])

        # 3. FR distribution
        all_fr_flat = all_fr.flatten()
        axes[0, 2].hist(all_fr_flat[all_fr_flat > 0], bins=50, log=True)
        axes[0, 2].set_title('Firing rate distribution (>0)')
        axes[0, 2].set_xlabel('FR (Hz)')

    # 4. Input: time from tone onset
    for t in range(min(10, n_trials)):
        axes[1, 0].plot(bin_centers, inputs[t][0], alpha=0.3)
    axes[1, 0].axvline(0, color='r', linestyle='--')
    axes[1, 0].set_title('Input: time from tone onset')
    axes[1, 0].set_xlabel('Time (s)')

    # 5. Input: photostim
    stim_trials = [t for t in range(n_trials) if np.any(inputs[t][1] > 0)]
    for t in stim_trials[:10]:
        axes[1, 1].plot(bin_centers, inputs[t][1], alpha=0.5)
    axes[1, 1].set_title(f'Input: photostim ({len(stim_trials)} stim trials)')
    axes[1, 1].set_xlabel('Time (s)')

    # 6. Output distributions
    choices = [outputs[t][0, 0] for t in range(n_trials)]
    outcomes_arr = [outputs[t][1, 0] for t in range(n_trials)]
    early_arr = [outputs[t][2, 0] for t in range(n_trials)]

    axes[1, 2].bar(['left', 'right'], [choices.count(0), choices.count(1)])
    axes[1, 2].set_title('Choice distribution')

    axes[2, 0].bar(['ignore', 'miss', 'hit'],
                   [outcomes_arr.count(0), outcomes_arr.count(1), outcomes_arr.count(2)])
    axes[2, 0].set_title('Outcome distribution')

    axes[2, 1].bar(['no early', 'early'], [early_arr.count(0), early_arr.count(1)])
    axes[2, 1].set_title('Early lick distribution')

    # 7. Tongue y discretized
    if n_trials > 0:
        for t in range(min(5, n_trials)):
            axes[2, 2].plot(bin_centers, outputs[t][3], alpha=0.5)
        axes[2, 2].set_title('Output: tongue y (discretized)')
        axes[2, 2].set_xlabel('Time (s)')
        axes[2, 2].set_yticks([0, 1, 2])

    # 8. Brain region distribution
    from collections import Counter
    region_counts = Counter(session_data['neuron_regions'])
    regions_sorted = sorted(region_counts.items(), key=lambda x: -x[1])
    axes[3, 0].barh([r[0] for r in regions_sorted], [r[1] for r in regions_sorted])
    axes[3, 0].set_title('Neurons per brain region')

    # 9. Mean FR by trial type (hit vs miss)
    if n_trials > 0 and n_neurons > 0:
        hit_frs = [neural[t] for t in range(n_trials) if outputs[t][1, 0] == 2]
        miss_frs = [neural[t] for t in range(n_trials) if outputs[t][1, 0] == 1]
        if hit_frs:
            axes[3, 1].plot(bin_centers, np.mean(np.stack(hit_frs), axis=(0, 1)), label='hit')
        if miss_frs:
            axes[3, 1].plot(bin_centers, np.mean(np.stack(miss_frs), axis=(0, 1)), label='miss')
        axes[3, 1].axvline(0, color='r', linestyle='--')
        axes[3, 1].set_title('Mean FR by outcome')
        axes[3, 1].legend()

    axes[3, 2].axis('off')
    axes[3, 2].text(0.1, 0.5, f'Neurons: {n_neurons}\nTrials: {n_trials}\n'
                    f'Correct rate: {session_data["correct_rate"]:.2f}\n'
                    f'Stim trials: {len(stim_trials)}',
                    fontsize=12, transform=axes[3, 2].transAxes, va='center')

    plt.tight_layout()
    plt.savefig(f'processing_{session_id}.png', dpi=100)
    plt.close()


def build_dataset(session_results):
    """Build the final dataset dictionary from session results."""

    # Collect unique subjects and brain regions
    subjects = []
    subject_idx = []
    all_brain_regions = set()

    for sess in session_results:
        if sess['subject_id'] not in subjects:
            subjects.append(sess['subject_id'])
        subject_idx.append(subjects.index(sess['subject_id']))
        all_brain_regions.update(sess['neuron_regions'])

    # Remove None from brain regions
    all_brain_regions.discard(None)
    brain_regions = sorted(list(all_brain_regions))

    # Build neural, input, output lists
    neural = []
    inputs = []
    outputs = []
    brain_region_idx = []

    for sess in session_results:
        neural.append(sess['neural_trials'])
        inputs.append(sess['input_trials'])
        outputs.append(sess['output_trials'])

        # Map neuron regions to indices
        region_indices = np.array([
            brain_regions.index(r) if r in brain_regions else 0
            for r in sess['neuron_regions']
        ])
        brain_region_idx.append(region_indices)

    data = {
        'neural': neural,
        'input': inputs,
        'output': outputs,
        'subjects': subjects,
        'subject_idx': np.array(subject_idx),
        'brain_regions': brain_regions,
        'brain_region_idx': brain_region_idx,
        'input_names': ['time_from_tone_onset', 'photostim_on'],
        'output_names': ['choice', 'outcome', 'early_lick', 'tongue_y'],
        'output_values': [
            ['left', 'right'],           # choice
            ['ignore', 'miss', 'hit'],   # outcome
            ['no', 'yes'],               # early_lick
            ['low', 'mid', 'high'],      # tongue_y
        ],
        'metadata': {
            'task_description': 'Auditory delayed response task: mice lick left or right port based on tone frequency after a delay period',
            'time_bin_size': BIN_WIDTH * 1000,  # in ms
            'temporal_alignment_event': 'Go cue onset',
            'off_start': T_START,
            'off_end': T_END,
            'dataset': 'MAP (Mesoscale Activity Map) - DANDI:000363',
            'paper': 'Chen et al., 2024, Cell',
            'n_sessions': len(session_results),
            'n_subjects': len(subjects),
        }
    }

    return data

# Main

def main():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description='Convert MAP NWB data to decoder format.')
    parser.add_argument('outfile', type=str, help='Output pickle file path')
    parser.add_argument('--full', action='store_true', default=True, help='Process all sessions (default)')
    parser.add_argument('--sample', action='store_true', help='Process only 2 sessions for testing')
    parser.add_argument('--show-processing', action='store_true', help='Generate processing plots')
    args = parser.parse_args()

    if args.sample:
        args.full = False

    print('=' * 60)
    print('MAP Dataset Conversion')
    print(f'Output: {args.outfile}')
    print(f'Mode: {"sample (2 sessions)" if args.sample else "full"}')
    print(f'Show processing: {args.show_processing}')
    print('=' * 60)

    t_total = time.time()

    # List all NWB files
    all_files = list_nwb_files(DATA_DIR)
    print(f'Found {len(all_files)} NWB files from {len(set(s for s, _ in all_files))} subjects')

    if args.sample:
        # Pick 2 sessions from different subjects that are likely to pass selection
        # Skip first session per subject (often training), take second sessions from 2 subjects
        selected = []
        seen_subjects = set()
        for sub, fpath in all_files:
            if sub in seen_subjects:
                if len(selected) < 2:
                    selected.append((sub, fpath))
                    seen_subjects.add(sub + '_done')
            else:
                seen_subjects.add(sub)
        all_files = selected[:2]
        print(f'Sample mode: processing {len(all_files)} sessions')

    # Process sessions
    session_results = []
    n_skipped = 0

    for i, (subject, nwb_path) in enumerate(all_files):
        print(f'\n[{i+1}/{len(all_files)}] {os.path.basename(nwb_path)}')
        t_sess = time.time()

        try:
            result = process_session(nwb_path,
                                    show_processing=args.show_processing,
                                    session_idx=i)
        except Exception as e:
            print(f'  ERROR: {e}')
            import traceback
            traceback.print_exc()
            n_skipped += 1
            continue

        if result is None:
            n_skipped += 1
            continue

        session_results.append(result)

        if args.show_processing and len(session_results) <= 2:
            make_processing_plots(result, len(session_results) - 1, nwb_path)

        elapsed = time.time() - t_sess

    total_trials = sum(s['n_trials'] for s in session_results)
    mean_trials = np.mean([s['n_trials'] for s in session_results])

    all_region_counts = Counter()
    for sess in session_results:

    for region in sorted(all_region_counts.keys()):

    all_outcomes = []
    all_early = []
    for sess_outputs in data['output']:
        for trial_out in sess_outputs:
            all_choices.append(int(trial_out[0, 0]))
            all_outcomes.append(int(trial_out[1, 0]))
            all_early.append(int(trial_out[2, 0]))

    print(f'    Outcome: ignore={all_outcomes.count(0)}, miss={all_outcomes.count(1)}, hit={all_outcomes.count(2)}')
    print(f'    Early lick: no={all_early.count(0)}, yes={all_early.count(1)}')

    # Save
    print(f'\nSaving to {args.outfile}...')
    with open(args.outfile, 'wb') as f:
        pickle.dump(data, f, protocol=4)

    file_size = os.path.getsize(args.outfile)
    print(f'Saved: {file_size / 1e6:.1f} MB')

    total_time = time.time() - t_total
    print(f'\nTotal time: {total_time/60:.1f} minutes')

   424→    anno_names = units['anno_name'][:]

   426→    good_indices_units = np.where(good_mask_units)[0]
   427→
   428→    if len(good_indices_units) == 0:
   429→        print(f'  SKIP: no good neurons')
   430→        io.close()
   431→        return None
   432→
   433→    # Get max recording time from obs_intervals of a representative unit
   434→    obs_intervals = units['obs_intervals'][good_indices_units[0]]
   435→    max_recording_time = obs_intervals[-1, 1] if len(obs_intervals) > 0 else 0
   436→
   437→    # ------ Trial filtering (behavioral + recording coverage) ------
   438→    valid_mask = behav_valid.copy()
   439→    valid_mask &= ~np.isnan(tone_onset_per_trial)
   440→
   441→    # Exclude trials beyond the neural recording period
   442→    for i in range(n_trials):
   443→        trial_end_abs = go_times[i] + T_END
   444→        if trial_end_abs > max_recording_time + 1.0:
   445→            valid_mask[i] = False
   446→
   447→    valid_indices = np.where(valid_mask)[0]
   448→
   449→    if len(valid_indices) < 2:
   450→        print(f'  SKIP: too few valid trials after recording filter ({len(valid_indices)})')
   451→        io.close()
   452→        return None
   453→
   454→    # ------ Extract good neurons ------
   455→    good_indices = good_indices_units
   456→    spike_times_all = units['spike_times']
   457→    spike_times_good = [spike_times_all[idx] for idx in good_indices]
   458→
   459→    annos_good = anno_names[good_mask_units]
   460→    neuron_regions = [map_anno_to_region(a) for a in annos_good]
   461→
   462→    n_neurons = len(good_indices)
   463→    print(f'  {n_neurons} good neurons, {len(valid_indices)} valid trials (of {n_trials}), correct rate={correct_rate:.2f}')
   464→
   465→    # ------ Compute firing rates per trial ------
   466→    neural_trials = []
   467→    input_trials = []
   468→    output_trials = []
   469→
   470→    # Get tongue tracking data for this session
   471→    bts = nwb.acquisition['BehavioralTimeSeries']
   472→    has_tongue = 'Camera0_side_TongueTracking' in bts.time_series
   473→    if has_tongue:
   474→        tongue_data = bts.time_series['Camera0_side_TongueTracking'].data[:]  # (n_frames, 3): x, y, likelihood
   475→        tongue_ts = bts.time_series['Camera0_side_TongueTracking'].timestamps[:]
   476→        tongue_y = tongue_data[:, 1]
   477→        tongue_likelihood = tongue_data[:, 2]
   478→
   479→    # Compute per-session tongue y percentiles for discretization
   480→    # Use all time points where tongue is visible (high likelihood)
   481→    if has_tongue:
   482→        tongue_visible = tongue_likelihood > 0.5
   483→        if np.sum(tongue_visible) > 100:
   484→            visible_y = tongue_y[tongue_visible]
   485→            p40 = np.percentile(visible_y, 40)
   486→            p60 = np.percentile(visible_y, 60)
   487→        else:
   488→            # Not enough visible tongue data
   489→            p40 = np.percentile(tongue_y, 40)
   490→            p60 = np.percentile(tongue_y, 60)
   491→
   492→    # Time bin centers relative to go cue
   493→    bin_centers = T_START + np.arange(N_BINS) * BIN_WIDTH + BIN_WIDTH / 2
   494→
   495→    for trial_idx in valid_indices:
   496→        go_time = go_times[trial_idx]
   497→
   498→        # --- Neural data: firing rates ---
   499→        fr = compute_firing_rates_vectorized(
   500→            spike_times_good, go_time, T_START, T_END, BIN_WIDTH, N_BINS
   501→        )  # (n_neurons, n_bins)
   502→        neural_trials.append(fr)
   503→
   504→        # --- Input 0: time from tone onset (seconds) ---
   505→        tone_time = tone_onset_per_trial[trial_idx]
   506→        tone_relative = tone_time - go_time  # tone onset relative to go cue (negative)
   507→        time_from_tone = bin_centers - tone_relative  # time since tone onset at each bin
   508→
   509→        # --- Input 1: photostimulation on/off ---
   510→        photostim = np.zeros(N_BINS, dtype=np.float32)
   511→        if photostim_onset[trial_idx] != 'N/A':
   512→            ps_onset = float(photostim_onset[trial_idx])
   513→            ps_duration = float(photostim_duration[trial_idx])
   514→            # photostim_onset is relative to trial start, need to convert to absolute then go-relative
   515→            # Actually check: is it absolute or relative?
   516→            # From NWB: photostim_onset is in seconds - need to check
   517→            # Let's check: photostim_start_times in BehavioralEvents has absolute times
   518→            # But trials table photostim_onset may be relative to go cue or absolute
   519→            # Let me compute relative to go cue
   520→            # The trial table stores these as strings, and from exploring data they look like
   521→            # they might be durations from trial start or absolute times
   522→            # Looking at the data: photostim_onset values are small (1.8) suggesting relative to trial start
   523→            ps_onset_abs = trial_starts[trial_idx] + ps_onset
   524→            ps_end_abs = ps_onset_abs + ps_duration
   525→            ps_onset_rel = ps_onset_abs - go_time
   526→            ps_end_rel = ps_end_abs - go_time
   527→
   528→            for b in range(N_BINS):
   529→                bc = bin_centers[b]
   530→                if ps_onset_rel <= bc < ps_end_rel:
   531→                    photostim[b] = 1.0
   532→
   533→        input_data = np.stack([time_from_tone.astype(np.float32), photostim], axis=0)  # (2, n_bins)
   534→        input_trials.append(input_data)
   535→
   536→        # --- Output 0: choice (left=0, right=1) ---
   537→        instr = instructions[trial_idx]
   538→        outcome = outcomes[trial_idx]
   539→        if outcome == 'hit':
   540→            choice = 0 if instr == 'left' else 1
   541→        elif outcome == 'miss':
   542→            choice = 1 if instr == 'left' else 0  # wrong lick = opposite
   543→        else:  # ignore
   544→            choice = 0 if instr == 'left' else 1  # assign instruction direction
   545→
   546→        # --- Output 1: outcome (ignore=0, miss=1, hit=2) ---
   547→        outcome_val = {'ignore': 0, 'miss': 1, 'hit': 2}[outcome]
   548→
   549→        # --- Output 2: early lick (no=0, yes=1) ---
   550→        early_val = 0 if early_licks[trial_idx] == 'no early' else 1
   551→
   552→        # --- Output 3: tongue y position (discretized, time-varying) ---
   553→        if has_tongue:
   554→            tongue_y_trial = np.zeros(N_BINS, dtype=np.float32)
   555→            for b in range(N_BINS):
   556→                bc_abs = go_time + bin_centers[b]
   557→                # Find closest tongue frame
   558→                t_idx = np.searchsorted(tongue_ts, bc_abs)
   559→                t_idx = min(t_idx, len(tongue_ts) - 1)
   560→                ty = tongue_y[t_idx]
   561→                if ty < p40:
   562→                    tongue_y_trial[b] = 0
   563→                elif ty < p60:
   564→                    tongue_y_trial[b] = 1
   565→                else:
   566→                    tongue_y_trial[b] = 2
   567→        else:
   568→            tongue_y_trial = np.ones(N_BINS, dtype=np.float32)  # default to middle
   569→
   570→        # Combine outputs: per-trial values + time-varying tongue
   571→        # Use int values for categorical outputs (required by decoder)
   572→        output_data = np.array([
   573→            np.full(N_BINS, choice, dtype=np.int64),
   574→            np.full(N_BINS, outcome_val, dtype=np.int64),
   575→            np.full(N_BINS, early_val, dtype=np.int64),
   576→            tongue_y_trial.astype(np.int64),
   577→        ], dtype=np.int64)  # (4, n_bins)
   578→        output_trials.append(output_data)
   579→
   580→    io.close()
   581→
   582→    elapsed = time.time() - t0
   583→    print(f'  Done in {elapsed:.1f}s')
   584→
   585→    return {
   586→        'neural_trials': neural_trials,
   587→        'input_trials': input_trials,
   588→        'output_trials': output_trials,
   589→        'neuron_regions': neuron_regions,
   590→        'subject_id': subject_id,
   591→        'session_id': session_id,
   592→        'n_neurons': n_neurons,
   593→        'n_trials': len(valid_indices),
   594→        'correct_rate': correct_rate,
   595→    }

   711→def build_dataset(session_results):
   712→    """Build the final dataset dictionary from session results."""
   713→
   714→    # Collect unique subjects and brain regions
   715→    subjects = []
   716→    subject_idx = []
   717→    all_brain_regions = set()
   718→
   719→    for sess in session_results:
   720→        if sess['subject_id'] not in subjects:
   721→            subjects.append(sess['subject_id'])
   722→        subject_idx.append(subjects.index(sess['subject_id']))
   723→        all_brain_regions.update(sess['neuron_regions'])
   724→
   725→    # Remove None from brain regions
   726→    all_brain_regions.discard(None)
   727→    brain_regions = sorted(list(all_brain_regions))
   728→
   729→    # Build neural, input, output lists
   730→    neural = []
   731→    inputs = []
   732→    outputs = []
   733→    brain_region_idx = []
   734→
   735→    for sess in session_results:
   736→        neural.append(sess['neural_trials'])
   737→        inputs.append(sess['input_trials'])
   738→        outputs.append(sess['output_trials'])
   739→
   740→        # Map neuron regions to indices
   741→        region_indices = np.array([
   742→            brain_regions.index(r) if r in brain_regions else 0
   743→            for r in sess['neuron_regions']
   744→        ])
   745→        brain_region_idx.append(region_indices)
   746→
   747→    data = {
   748→        'neural': neural,
   749→        'input': inputs,
   750→        'output': outputs,
   751→        'subjects': subjects,
   752→        'subject_idx': np.array(subject_idx),
   753→        'brain_regions': brain_regions,
   754→        'brain_region_idx': brain_region_idx,
   755→        'input_names': ['time_from_tone_onset', 'photostim_on'],
   756→        'output_names': ['choice', 'outcome', 'early_lick', 'tongue_y'],
   757→        'output_values': [
   758→            ['left', 'right'],           # choice
   759→            ['ignore', 'miss', 'hit'],   # outcome
   760→            ['no', 'yes'],               # early_lick
   761→            ['low', 'mid', 'high'],      # tongue_y
   762→        ],
   763→        'metadata': {
   764→            'task_description': 'Auditory delayed response task: mice lick left or right port based on tone frequency after a delay period',
   765→            'time_bin_size': BIN_WIDTH * 1000,  # in ms
   766→            'temporal_alignment_event': 'Go cue onset',
   767→            'off_start': T_START,
   768→            'off_end': T_END,
   769→            'dataset': 'MAP (Mesoscale Activity Map) - DANDI:000363',
   770→            'paper': 'Chen et al., 2024, Cell',
   771→            'n_sessions': len(session_results),
   772→            'n_subjects': len(subjects),
   773→        }
   774→    }
   775→
   776→    return data

def map_anno_to_region(anno_name):
    """Map a detailed CCF annotation to a broad brain region category."""
    if not anno_name or anno_name == '':
        return None
    # Try exact match first
    if anno_name in REGION_MAPPING:
        return REGION_MAPPING[anno_name]
    # Try prefix matching (handles layer suffixes like ", layer 5")
    for prefix, region in REGION_MAPPING.items():
        if anno_name.startswith(prefix):
            return REGION_MAPPING[prefix]
    # Try substring matching for complex names
    anno_lower = anno_name.lower()
    if 'thalamus' in anno_lower or 'thalamic' in anno_lower:
        return 'Thalamus'
    if 'hypothal' in anno_lower:
        return 'Hypothalamus'
    if 'cerebel' in anno_lower:
        return 'Cerebellum'
    if 'medulla' in anno_lower or 'medullar' in anno_lower:
        return 'Medulla'
    if 'midbrain' in anno_lower:
        return 'Midbrain'
    if 'hippocam' in anno_lower:
        return 'Hippocampus'
    if 'olfact' in anno_lower or 'piriform' in anno_lower:
        return 'Olfactory'
    if 'striatum' in anno_lower or 'putamen' in anno_lower:
        return 'Striatum'
    if 'pallid' in anno_lower or 'pallidum' in anno_lower:
        return 'Pallidum'
    if 'cortex' in anno_lower or 'cortical' in anno_lower:
        return 'OtherCortex'
    if 'amygdal' in anno_lower:
        return 'CorticalSubplate'
    if 'pons' in anno_lower or 'pontine' in anno_lower:
        return 'Pons'
    # Fallback
    print(f'  WARNING: Unmapped annotation: "{anno_name}"')
    return 'OtherCortex'

def list_nwb_files(data_dir):
    """List all NWB files organized by subject."""
    subjects = sorted([d for d in os.listdir(data_dir)
                      if os.path.isdir(os.path.join(data_dir, d)) and d.startswith('sub-')])
    all_files = []
    for sub in subjects:
        sub_dir = os.path.join(data_dir, sub)
        nwb_files = sorted([os.path.join(sub_dir, f)
                           for f in os.listdir(sub_dir) if f.endswith('.nwb')])
        for nwb_file in nwb_files:
            all_files.append((sub, nwb_file))
    return all_files


def compute_firing_rates_vectorized(spike_times_list, go_time, t_start, t_end, bin_width, n_bins):
    """
    Compute firing rates for all neurons from spike times.

    Args:
        spike_times_list: list of arrays, one per neuron (absolute times)
        go_time: float, go cue time (absolute)
        t_start, t_end: window relative to go_time
        bin_width: bin width in seconds
        n_bins: number of bins

    Returns:
        fr: (n_neurons, n_bins) firing rate array
    """
    n_neurons = len(spike_times_list)
    fr = np.zeros((n_neurons, n_bins), dtype=np.float32)
    bin_edges_start = go_time + t_start + np.arange(n_bins) * bin_width
    bin_edges_end = bin_edges_start + bin_width

    for i, spk in enumerate(spike_times_list):
        if len(spk) == 0:
            continue
        # Only keep spikes in our window
        mask = (spk >= go_time + t_start) & (spk < go_time + t_end)
        spk_window = spk[mask]
        if len(spk_window) == 0:
            continue
        # Assign spikes to bins
        bin_idx = np.floor((spk_window - (go_time + t_start)) / bin_width).astype(int)
        bin_idx = np.clip(bin_idx, 0, n_bins - 1)
        np.add.at(fr[i], bin_idx, 1)

    fr /= bin_width  # convert to firing rate (Hz)
    return fr


def process_session(nwb_path, show_processing=False, session_idx=0):
    """
    Process one NWB session file.

    Returns:
        dict with session data, or None if session should be skipped.
    """
    t0 = time.time()

    io = pynwb.NWBHDF5IO(nwb_path, 'r')
    nwb = io.read()

    # Extract subject info
    subject_id = nwb.subject.subject_id if nwb.subject else os.path.basename(nwb_path).split('_')[0]
    session_id = nwb.identifier

    print(f'  Processing {session_id}...')

    # ------ Extract trial info ------
    trials = nwb.trials
    n_trials = len(trials)
    trial_starts = trials['start_time'][:]
    trial_stops = trials['stop_time'][:]
    instructions = trials['trial_instruction'][:]  # 'left' or 'right'
    outcomes = trials['outcome'][:]  # 'hit', 'miss', 'ignore'
    early_licks = trials['early_lick'][:]  # 'early' or 'no early'
    auto_water = trials['auto_water'][:]  # 0 or 1
    free_water = trials['free_water'][:]  # 0 or 1
    photostim_onset = trials['photostim_onset'][:]  # time or 'N/A'
    photostim_duration = trials['photostim_duration'][:]  # duration or 'N/A'

    # ------ Get go cue times ------
    be = nwb.acquisition['BehavioralEvents']
    go_times = be.time_series['go_start_times'].timestamps[:]

    assert len(go_times) == n_trials, f"Go times ({len(go_times)}) != trials ({n_trials})"

    # ------ Get sample (tone) onset times for each trial ------
    sample_starts = be.time_series['sample_start_times'].timestamps[:]

    # Map sample_start to each trial: find the last sample_start before the go cue within each trial
    tone_onset_per_trial = np.full(n_trials, np.nan)
    for i in range(n_trials):
        # Find sample events within this trial's window
        in_trial = sample_starts[(sample_starts >= trial_starts[i]) & (sample_starts <= go_times[i])]
        if len(in_trial) > 0:
            # Take the LAST sample onset (in case of replays from early licking)
            tone_onset_per_trial[i] = in_trial[-1]

    # ------ Session selection criteria (applied to ALL behavioral trials) ------
    # These criteria use the full session behavioral data, per the paper
    behav_valid = (auto_water == 0) & (free_water == 0)
    control_mask = behav_valid.copy()
    for i in range(n_trials):
        if photostim_onset[i] != 'N/A':
            control_mask[i] = False
        if early_licks[i] == 'early':
            control_mask[i] = False

    n_control = np.sum(control_mask)
    if n_control > 0:
        correct_control = np.sum(control_mask & (outcomes == 'hit'))
        correct_rate = correct_control / n_control
    else:
        correct_rate = 0.0

    correct_left = np.sum(control_mask & (outcomes == 'hit') & (instructions == 'left'))
    correct_right = np.sum(control_mask & (outcomes == 'hit') & (instructions == 'right'))

    if correct_rate < MIN_CORRECT_RATE:
        print(f'  SKIP: correct rate {correct_rate:.2f} < {MIN_CORRECT_RATE}')
        io.close()
        return None

    if correct_left < MIN_CORRECT_LEFT or correct_right < MIN_CORRECT_RIGHT:
        print(f'  SKIP: correct left={correct_left}, right={correct_right} (need >={MIN_CORRECT_LEFT} each)')
        io.close()
        return None

    # ------ Determine recording coverage ------
    units = nwb.units
    classification = units['classification'][:]
    good_mask_units = classification == 'good'
    anno_names = units['anno_name'][:]
    good_mask_units &= np.array([a != '' and a is not None for a in anno_names])
    good_indices_units = np.where(good_mask_units)[0]

    if len(good_indices_units) == 0:
        print(f'  SKIP: no good neurons')
        io.close()
        return None

    # Get max recording time from obs_intervals of a representative unit
    obs_intervals = units['obs_intervals'][good_indices_units[0]]
    max_recording_time = obs_intervals[-1, 1] if len(obs_intervals) > 0 else 0

    # ------ Trial filtering (behavioral + recording coverage) ------
    valid_mask = behav_valid.copy()
    valid_mask &= ~np.isnan(tone_onset_per_trial)

    # Exclude trials beyond the neural recording period
    for i in range(n_trials):
        trial_end_abs = go_times[i] + T_END
        if trial_end_abs > max_recording_time + 1.0:
            valid_mask[i] = False

    valid_indices = np.where(valid_mask)[0]

    if len(valid_indices) < 2:
        print(f'  SKIP: too few valid trials after recording filter ({len(valid_indices)})')
        io.close()
        return None

    # ------ Extract good neurons ------
    good_indices = good_indices_units
    spike_times_all = units['spike_times']
    spike_times_good = [spike_times_all[idx] for idx in good_indices]

    annos_good = anno_names[good_mask_units]
    neuron_regions = [map_anno_to_region(a) for a in annos_good]

    n_neurons = len(good_indices)
    print(f'  {n_neurons} good neurons, {len(valid_indices)} valid trials (of {n_trials}), correct rate={correct_rate:.2f}')

    # ------ Compute firing rates per trial ------
    neural_trials = []
    input_trials = []
    output_trials = []

    # Get tongue tracking data for this session
    bts = nwb.acquisition['BehavioralTimeSeries']
    has_tongue = 'Camera0_side_TongueTracking' in bts.time_series
    if has_tongue:
        tongue_data = bts.time_series['Camera0_side_TongueTracking'].data[:]  # (n_frames, 3): x, y, likelihood
        tongue_ts = bts.time_series['Camera0_side_TongueTracking'].timestamps[:]
        tongue_y = tongue_data[:, 1]
        tongue_likelihood = tongue_data[:, 2]

    # Compute per-session tongue y percentiles for discretization
    # Use all time points where tongue is visible (high likelihood)
    if has_tongue:
        tongue_visible = tongue_likelihood > 0.5
        if np.sum(tongue_visible) > 100:
            visible_y = tongue_y[tongue_visible]
            p40 = np.percentile(visible_y, 40)
            p60 = np.percentile(visible_y, 60)
        else:
            # Not enough visible tongue data
            p40 = np.percentile(tongue_y, 40)
            p60 = np.percentile(tongue_y, 60)

    # Time bin centers relative to go cue
    bin_centers = T_START + np.arange(N_BINS) * BIN_WIDTH + BIN_WIDTH / 2

    for trial_idx in valid_indices:
        go_time = go_times[trial_idx]

        # --- Neural data: firing rates ---
        fr = compute_firing_rates_vectorized(
            spike_times_good, go_time, T_START, T_END, BIN_WIDTH, N_BINS
        )  # (n_neurons, n_bins)
        neural_trials.append(fr)

        # --- Input 0: time from tone onset (seconds) ---
        tone_time = tone_onset_per_trial[trial_idx]
        tone_relative = tone_time - go_time  # tone onset relative to go cue (negative)
        time_from_tone = bin_centers - tone_relative  # time since tone onset at each bin

        # --- Input 1: photostimulation on/off ---
        photostim = np.zeros(N_BINS, dtype=np.float32)
        if photostim_onset[trial_idx] != 'N/A':
            ps_onset = float(photostim_onset[trial_idx])
            ps_duration = float(photostim_duration[trial_idx])
            # photostim_onset is relative to trial start, need to convert to absolute then go-relative
            # Actually check: is it absolute or relative?
            # From NWB: photostim_onset is in seconds - need to check
            # Let's check: photostim_start_times in BehavioralEvents has absolute times
            # But trials table photostim_onset may be relative to go cue or absolute
            # Let me compute relative to go cue
            # The trial table stores these as strings, and from exploring data they look like
            # they might be durations from trial start or absolute times
            # Looking at the data: photostim_onset values are small (1.8) suggesting relative to trial start
            ps_onset_abs = trial_starts[trial_idx] + ps_onset
            ps_end_abs = ps_onset_abs + ps_duration
            ps_onset_rel = ps_onset_abs - go_time
            ps_end_rel = ps_end_abs - go_time

            for b in range(N_BINS):
                bc = bin_centers[b]
                if ps_onset_rel <= bc < ps_end_rel:
                    photostim[b] = 1.0

        input_data = np.stack([time_from_tone.astype(np.float32), photostim], axis=0)  # (2, n_bins)
        input_trials.append(input_data)

        # --- Output 0: choice (left=0, right=1) ---
        instr = instructions[trial_idx]
        outcome = outcomes[trial_idx]
        if outcome == 'hit':
            choice = 0 if instr == 'left' else 1
        elif outcome == 'miss':
            choice = 1 if instr == 'left' else 0  # wrong lick = opposite
        else:  # ignore
            choice = 0 if instr == 'left' else 1  # assign instruction direction

        # --- Output 1: outcome (ignore=0, miss=1, hit=2) ---
        outcome_val = {'ignore': 0, 'miss': 1, 'hit': 2}[outcome]

        # --- Output 2: early lick (no=0, yes=1) ---
        early_val = 0 if early_licks[trial_idx] == 'no early' else 1

        # --- Output 3: tongue y position (discretized, time-varying) ---
        if has_tongue:
            tongue_y_trial = np.zeros(N_BINS, dtype=np.float32)
            for b in range(N_BINS):
                bc_abs = go_time + bin_centers[b]
                # Find closest tongue frame
                t_idx = np.searchsorted(tongue_ts, bc_abs)
                t_idx = min(t_idx, len(tongue_ts) - 1)
                ty = tongue_y[t_idx]
                if ty < p40:
                    tongue_y_trial[b] = 0
                elif ty < p60:
                    tongue_y_trial[b] = 1
                else:
                    tongue_y_trial[b] = 2
        else:
            tongue_y_trial = np.ones(N_BINS, dtype=np.float32)  # default to middle

        # Combine outputs: per-trial values + time-varying tongue
        # Use int values for categorical outputs (required by decoder)
        output_data = np.array([
            np.full(N_BINS, choice, dtype=np.int64),
            np.full(N_BINS, outcome_val, dtype=np.int64),
            np.full(N_BINS, early_val, dtype=np.int64),
            tongue_y_trial.astype(np.int64),
        ], dtype=np.int64)  # (4, n_bins)
        output_trials.append(output_data)

    io.close()

    elapsed = time.time() - t0
    print(f'  Done in {elapsed:.1f}s')

    return {
        'neural_trials': neural_trials,
        'input_trials': input_trials,
        'output_trials': output_trials,
        'neuron_regions': neuron_regions,
        'subject_id': subject_id,
        'session_id': session_id,
        'n_neurons': n_neurons,
        'n_trials': len(valid_indices),
        'correct_rate': correct_rate,
    }


def make_processing_plots(session_data, session_idx, nwb_path):
    """Generate processing visualization plots for a session."""
    import matplotlib
    matplotlib.use('Agg')
    import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

    neural = session_data['neural_trials']
    inputs = session_data['input_trials']
    outputs = session_data['output_trials']
    session_id = session_data['session_id']

    n_trials = len(neural)
    n_neurons = neural[0].shape[0] if n_trials > 0 else 0

    bin_centers = T_START + np.arange(N_BINS) * BIN_WIDTH + BIN_WIDTH / 2

    fig, axes = plt.subplots(4, 3, figsize=(18, 16))
    fig.suptitle(f'Session: {session_id}\n{n_neurons} neurons, {n_trials} trials', fontsize=14)

    # 1. Mean firing rate across neurons and trials
    if n_trials > 0 and n_neurons > 0:
        all_fr = np.stack(neural)  # (n_trials, n_neurons, n_bins)
        mean_fr = np.mean(all_fr, axis=(0, 1))
        axes[0, 0].plot(bin_centers, mean_fr)
        axes[0, 0].axvline(0, color='r', linestyle='--', label='Go cue')
        axes[0, 0].set_title('Mean firing rate')
        axes[0, 0].set_xlabel('Time (s)')
        axes[0, 0].set_ylabel('FR (Hz)')
        axes[0, 0].legend()

        # 2. Single trial neural activity (heatmap)
        trial_idx = min(5, n_trials - 1)
        im = axes[0, 1].imshow(neural[trial_idx][:min(50, n_neurons)],
                               aspect='auto', extent=[T_START, T_END, 0, min(50, n_neurons)])
        axes[0, 1].axvline(0, color='r', linestyle='--')
        axes[0, 1].set_title(f'Trial {trial_idx} neural activity')
        axes[0, 1].set_xlabel('Time (s)')
        axes[0, 1].set_ylabel('Neuron')
        plt.colorbar(im, ax=axes[0, 1])

        # 3. FR distribution
        all_fr_flat = all_fr.flatten()
        axes[0, 2].hist(all_fr_flat[all_fr_flat > 0], bins=50, log=True)
        axes[0, 2].set_title('Firing rate distribution (>0)')
        axes[0, 2].set_xlabel('FR (Hz)')

    # 4. Input: time from tone onset
    for t in range(min(10, n_trials)):
        axes[1, 0].plot(bin_centers, inputs[t][0], alpha=0.3)
    axes[1, 0].axvline(0, color='r', linestyle='--')
    axes[1, 0].set_title('Input: time from tone onset')
    axes[1, 0].set_xlabel('Time (s)')

    # 5. Input: photostim
    stim_trials = [t for t in range(n_trials) if np.any(inputs[t][1] > 0)]
    for t in stim_trials[:10]:
        axes[1, 1].plot(bin_centers, inputs[t][1], alpha=0.5)
    axes[1, 1].set_title(f'Input: photostim ({len(stim_trials)} stim trials)')
    axes[1, 1].set_xlabel('Time (s)')

    # 6. Output distributions
    choices = [outputs[t][0, 0] for t in range(n_trials)]
    outcomes_arr = [outputs[t][1, 0] for t in range(n_trials)]
    early_arr = [outputs[t][2, 0] for t in range(n_trials)]

    axes[1, 2].bar(['left', 'right'], [choices.count(0), choices.count(1)])
    axes[1, 2].set_title('Choice distribution')

    axes[2, 0].bar(['ignore', 'miss', 'hit'],
                   [outcomes_arr.count(0), outcomes_arr.count(1), outcomes_arr.count(2)])
    axes[2, 0].set_title('Outcome distribution')

    axes[2, 1].bar(['no early', 'early'], [early_arr.count(0), early_arr.count(1)])
    axes[2, 1].set_title('Early lick distribution')

    # 7. Tongue y discretized
    if n_trials > 0:
        for t in range(min(5, n_trials)):
            axes[2, 2].plot(bin_centers, outputs[t][3], alpha=0.5)
        axes[2, 2].set_title('Output: tongue y (discretized)')
        axes[2, 2].set_xlabel('Time (s)')
        axes[2, 2].set_yticks([0, 1, 2])

    # 8. Brain region distribution
    from collections import Counter
    region_counts = Counter(session_data['neuron_regions'])
    regions_sorted = sorted(region_counts.items(), key=lambda x: -x[1])
    axes[3, 0].barh([r[0] for r in regions_sorted], [r[1] for r in regions_sorted])
    axes[3, 0].set_title('Neurons per brain region')

    # 9. Mean FR by trial type (hit vs miss)
    if n_trials > 0 and n_neurons > 0:
        hit_frs = [neural[t] for t in range(n_trials) if outputs[t][1, 0] == 2]
        miss_frs = [neural[t] for t in range(n_trials) if outputs[t][1, 0] == 1]
        if hit_frs:
            axes[3, 1].plot(bin_centers, np.mean(np.stack(hit_frs), axis=(0, 1)), label='hit')
        if miss_frs:
            axes[3, 1].plot(bin_centers, np.mean(np.stack(miss_frs), axis=(0, 1)), label='miss')
        axes[3, 1].axvline(0, color='r', linestyle='--')
        axes[3, 1].set_title('Mean FR by outcome')
        axes[3, 1].legend()

    axes[3, 2].axis('off')
    axes[3, 2].text(0.1, 0.5, f'Neurons: {n_neurons}\nTrials: {n_trials}\n'
                    f'Correct rate: {session_data["correct_rate"]:.2f}\n'
                    f'Stim trials: {len(stim_trials)}',
                    fontsize=12, transform=axes[3, 2].transAxes, va='center')

    plt.tight_layout()
    plt.savefig(f'processing_{session_id}.png', dpi=100)
    plt.close()


def build_dataset(session_results):
    """Build the final dataset dictionary from session results."""

    # Collect unique subjects and brain regions
    subjects = []
    subject_idx = []
    all_brain_regions = set()

    for sess in session_results:
        if sess['subject_id'] not in subjects:
            subjects.append(sess['subject_id'])
        subject_idx.append(subjects.index(sess['subject_id']))
        all_brain_regions.update(sess['neuron_regions'])

    # Remove None from brain regions
    all_brain_regions.discard(None)
    brain_regions = sorted(list(all_brain_regions))

    # Build neural, input, output lists
    neural = []
    inputs = []
    outputs = []
    brain_region_idx = []

    for sess in session_results:
        neural.append(sess['neural_trials'])
        inputs.append(sess['input_trials'])
        outputs.append(sess['output_trials'])

        # Map neuron regions to indices
        region_indices = np.array([
            brain_regions.index(r) if r in brain_regions else 0
            for r in sess['neuron_regions']
        ])
        brain_region_idx.append(region_indices)

    data = {
        'neural': neural,
        'input': inputs,
        'output': outputs,
        'subjects': subjects,
        'subject_idx': np.array(subject_idx),
        'brain_regions': brain_regions,
        'brain_region_idx': brain_region_idx,
        'input_names': ['time_from_tone_onset', 'photostim_on'],
        'output_names': ['choice', 'outcome', 'early_lick', 'tongue_y'],
        'output_values': [
            ['left', 'right'],           # choice
            ['ignore', 'miss', 'hit'],   # outcome
            ['no', 'yes'],               # early_lick
            ['low', 'mid', 'high'],      # tongue_y
        ],
        'metadata': {
            'task_description': 'Auditory delayed response task: mice lick left or right port based on tone frequency after a delay period',
            'time_bin_size': BIN_WIDTH * 1000,  # in ms
            'temporal_alignment_event': 'Go cue onset',
            'off_start': T_START,
            'off_end': T_END,
            'dataset': 'MAP (Mesoscale Activity Map) - DANDI:000363',
            'paper': 'Chen et al., 2024, Cell',
            'n_sessions': len(session_results),
            'n_subjects': len(subjects),
        }
    }

    return data


# ============================================================
# Main
# ============================================================

def main():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description='Convert MAP NWB data to decoder format.')
    parser.add_argument('outfile', type=str, help='Output pickle file path')
    parser.add_argument('--full', action='store_true', default=True, help='Process all sessions (default)')
    parser.add_argument('--sample', action='store_true', help='Process only 2 sessions for testing')
    parser.add_argument('--show-processing', action='store_true', help='Generate processing plots')
    args = parser.parse_args()

    if args.sample:
        args.full = False

    print('=' * 60)
    print('MAP Dataset Conversion')
    print(f'Output: {args.outfile}')
    print(f'Mode: {"sample (2 sessions)" if args.sample else "full"}')
    print(f'Show processing: {args.show_processing}')
    print('=' * 60)

    t_total = time.time()

    # List all NWB files
    all_files = list_nwb_files(DATA_DIR)
    print(f'Found {len(all_files)} NWB files from {len(set(s for s, _ in all_files))} subjects')

    if args.sample:
        # Pick 2 sessions from different subjects that are likely to pass selection
        # Skip first session per subject (often training), take second sessions from 2 subjects
        selected = []
        seen_subjects = set()
        for sub, fpath in all_files:
            if sub in seen_subjects:
                if len(selected) < 2:
                    selected.append((sub, fpath))
                    seen_subjects.add(sub + '_done')
            else:
                seen_subjects.add(sub)
        all_files = selected[:2]
        print(f'Sample mode: processing {len(all_files)} sessions')

    # Process sessions
    session_results = []
    n_skipped = 0

    for i, (subject, nwb_path) in enumerate(all_files):
        print(f'\n[{i+1}/{len(all_files)}] {os.path.basename(nwb_path)}')
        t_sess = time.time()

        try:
            result = process_session(nwb_path,
                                    show_processing=args.show_processing,
                                    session_idx=i)
        except Exception as e:
            print(f'  ERROR: {e}')
            import traceback
            traceback.print_exc()
            n_skipped += 1
            continue

        if result is None:
            n_skipped += 1
            continue

        session_results.append(result)

        if args.show_processing and len(session_results) <= 2:
            make_processing_plots(result, len(session_results) - 1, nwb_path)

        elapsed = time.time() - t_sess
        # Estimate remaining time
        avg_time = (time.time() - t_total) / (i + 1)
        remaining = avg_time * (len(all_files) - i - 1)
        print(f'  Elapsed: {elapsed:.1f}s, Est remaining: {remaining/60:.1f} min')

    print(f'\n{"=" * 60}')
    print(f'Processed: {len(session_results)} sessions, Skipped: {n_skipped}')

    if len(session_results) == 0:
        print('ERROR: No sessions processed!')
        sys.exit(1)

    # Build final dataset
    print('Building final dataset...')
    data = build_dataset(session_results)

    # Print summary statistics
    total_neurons = sum(s['n_neurons'] for s in session_results)
    total_trials = sum(s['n_trials'] for s in session_results)
    mean_trials = np.mean([s['n_trials'] for s in session_results])
    mean_neurons = np.mean([s['n_neurons'] for s in session_results])

    print(f'\nDataset Summary:')
    print(f'  Subjects: {len(data["subjects"])}')
    print(f'  Sessions: {len(session_results)}')
    print(f'  Total neurons: {total_neurons}')
    print(f'  Mean neurons/session: {mean_neurons:.1f}')
    print(f'  Total trials: {total_trials}')
    print(f'  Mean trials/session: {mean_trials:.1f}')
    print(f'  Brain regions: {data["brain_regions"]}')

    # Region neuron counts
    from collections import Counter
    all_region_counts = Counter()
    for sess in session_results:
        all_region_counts.update(sess['neuron_regions'])
    print(f'\n  Neurons per region:')
    for region in sorted(all_region_counts.keys()):
        print(f'    {region}: {all_region_counts[region]}')

    # Output distributions
    all_choices = []
    all_outcomes = []
    all_early = []
    for sess_outputs in data['output']:
        for trial_out in sess_outputs:
            all_choices.append(int(trial_out[0, 0]))
            all_outcomes.append(int(trial_out[1, 0]))
            all_early.append(int(trial_out[2, 0]))

    print(f'\n  Output distributions:')
    print(f'    Choice: left={all_choices.count(0)}, right={all_choices.count(1)}')
    print(f'    Outcome: ignore={all_outcomes.count(0)}, miss={all_outcomes.count(1)}, hit={all_outcomes.count(2)}')
    print(f'    Early lick: no={all_early.count(0)}, yes={all_early.count(1)}')

    # Save
    print(f'\nSaving to {args.outfile}...')
    with open(args.outfile, 'wb') as f:
        pickle.dump(data, f, protocol=4)

    file_size = os.path.getsize(args.outfile)
    print(f'Saved: {file_size / 1e6:.1f} MB')

    total_time = time.time() - t_total
    print(f'\nTotal time: {total_time/60:.1f} minutes')


if __name__ == '__main__':
    main()

   245→def map_anno_to_region(anno_name):
   246→    """Map a detailed CCF annotation to a broad brain region category."""
   247→    if not anno_name or anno_name == '':
   248→        return None
   249→    # Try exact match first
   250→    if anno_name in REGION_MAPPING:
   251→        return REGION_MAPPING[anno_name]
   252→    # Try prefix matching (handles layer suffixes like ", layer 5")
   253→    for prefix, region in REGION_MAPPING.items():
   254→        if anno_name.startswith(prefix):
   255→            return REGION_MAPPING[prefix]
   256→    # Try substring matching for complex names
   257→    anno_lower = anno_name.lower()
   258→    if 'thalamus' in anno_lower or 'thalamic' in anno_lower:
   259→        return 'Thalamus'
   260→    if 'hypothal' in anno_lower:
   261→        return 'Hypothalamus'
   262→    if 'cerebel' in anno_lower:
   263→        return 'Cerebellum'
   264→    if 'medulla' in anno_lower or 'medullar' in anno_lower:
   265→        return 'Medulla'
   266→    if 'midbrain' in anno_lower:
   267→        return 'Midbrain'
   268→    if 'hippocam' in anno_lower:
   269→        return 'Hippocampus'
   270→    if 'olfact' in anno_lower or 'piriform' in anno_lower:
   271→        return 'Olfactory'
   272→    if 'striatum' in anno_lower or 'putamen' in anno_lower:
   273→        return 'Striatum'
   274→    if 'pallid' in anno_lower or 'pallidum' in anno_lower:
   275→        return 'Pallidum'
   276→    if 'cortex' in anno_lower or 'cortical' in anno_lower:
   277→        return 'OtherCortex'
   278→    if 'amygdal' in anno_lower:
   279→        return 'CorticalSubplate'
   280→    if 'pons' in anno_lower or 'pontine' in anno_lower:
   281→        return 'Pons'
   282→    # Fallback
   283→    print(f'  WARNING: Unmapped annotation: "{anno_name}"')
   284→    return 'OtherCortex'

   291→def list_nwb_files(data_dir):
